verses.text: Then the family leaders of the Levites came to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the family leaders of the other tribes of Israel.
At Shiloh in the land of Canaan they said to them, "The LORD commanded through Moses that you give us towns to live in, with fields around them for our animals."
So, as the LORD had commanded, the Israelites gave the Levites these towns and fields from their own land.
The first lot came out for the Kohathite clans. The descendants of Aaron the priest, who were Levites, received thirteen towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin.
The rest of Kohath's descendants received ten towns from the clans of the tribes of Ephraim and Dan and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
The descendants of Gershon received thirteen towns from the clans of the tribes of Issachar, Asher and Naphtali and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
The descendants of Merari, clan by clan, received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad and Zebulun.
So the Israelites gave these towns and their fields to the Levites by lot, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.
From the tribes of Judah and Simeon they gave the following towns, named here.
They went to the descendants of Aaron from the Kohathite clans of the Levites, because the first lot came out for them.
They gave them Kiriath Arba, which is Hebron, with the fields around it, in the hill country of Judah. Arba was the father of Anak.
But the farmland and villages around the city had already been given to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his own.
So to the descendants of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron, a city of safety for anyone who had killed someone, together with Libnah,
Jattir, Eshtemoa,
Holon, Debir,
Ain, Juttah and Beth Shemesh, each with its fields. That was nine towns from these two tribes.
From the tribe of Benjamin they gave them Gibeon, Geba,
Anathoth and Almon, each with its fields. That was four towns.
In all, the priests descended from Aaron received thirteen towns with their fields.
The rest of the Kohathite clans of the Levites received towns by lot from the tribe of Ephraim.
They received Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, a city of safety for anyone who had killed someone, and Gezer,
Kibzaim and Beth Horon, each with its fields. That was four towns.
From the tribe of Dan they received Eltekeh, Gibbethon,
Aijalon and Gath Rimmon, each with its fields. That was four towns.
From the half-tribe of Manasseh they received Taanach and Gath Rimmon, each with its fields. That was two towns.
In all, the rest of the Kohathite clans received ten towns with their fields.

The Gershonite clans of the Levites received from the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan, a city of safety for anyone who had killed someone, and Be Eshterah, each with its fields. That was two towns.
From the tribe of Issachar they received Kishion, Daberath,
Jarmuth and En Gannim, each with its fields. That was four towns.
From the tribe of Asher they received Mishal, Abdon,
Helkath and Rehob, each with its fields. That was four towns.
From the tribe of Naphtali they received Kedesh in Galilee, a city of safety for anyone who had killed someone, Hammoth Dor and Kartan, each with its fields. That was three towns.
In all, the Gershonite clans received thirteen towns with their fields.
The Merarite clans, the rest of the Levites, received from the tribe of Zebulun Jokneam, Kartah,
Dimnah and Nahalal, each with its fields. That was four towns.
From the tribe of Reuben they received Bezer, Jahaz,
Kedemoth and Mephaath, each with its fields. That was four towns.
From the tribe of Gad they received Ramoth in Gilead, a city of safety for anyone who had killed someone, Mahanaim,
Heshbon and Jazer, each with its fields. That was four towns in all.
In all, the Merarite clans, the last of the Levite clans, received twelve towns by lot.
Altogether the Levites received forty-eight towns with their fields inside the land of the Israelites.
Each of these towns had fields around it. This was true for all of them.
So the LORD gave Israel all the land he had sworn to give their ancestors. They took it and settled there.
The LORD gave them rest on every side, just as he had sworn to their ancestors. Not one of their enemies could stand against them. The LORD gave all their enemies into their hands.
Not one of all the good promises the LORD had made to the people of Israel failed. Every one came true.
